description: Optimize multi-product shopping carts to minimize total cost including shipping across German and Austrian bike shops. Compare prices for bicycle parts, components, accessories, and cycling clothing. Covers over 100,000 products. Supports DE and AT markets. Call get_shop_info for the current list of supported shops.
instructions: Bikefuchs is a bicycle parts price comparison and cart optimization service for German and Austrian cyclists. Use search_product for text search, get_best_price for EAN/GTIN lookup, optimize_cart for multi-product cart optimization with shipping cost minimization, get_shop_info for shop overview, get_shipping_breakdown for shipping cost details, find_alternatives_for_product to check which shops carry a product, and resolve_product to turn a product page URL into a comparable product.

tools.name: search_product
tools.title: Search Products
tools.description: Find and compare prices for bicycle parts, components, accessories, and cycling clothing across German and Austrian bike shops. Search by product name, brand, or model number. Returns real-time prices, stock availability, and direct purchase links. Covers MTB, road bike, gravel, e-bike, and city bike parts.

q.description: Search query (product name, brand, model number)

tools.name: get_best_price
tools.title: Get Best Price
tools.description: Look up a specific bicycle product by its EAN/GTIN barcode number and find the best price across all supported shops. Returns prices from every shop that carries the product, sorted cheapest first, with stock status and affiliate purchase links.

tools.name: optimize_cart
tools.title: Optimize Shopping Cart
tools.description: Optimize a shopping cart of bicycle products across multiple shops to find the cheapest total cost including shipping. Provide product EAN/GTIN barcodes from supported shops and get the optimal shop combination that minimizes total spend. Accounts for per-shop shipping costs, free-shipping thresholds, and country-specific pricing (DE/AT).

eans.description: Array of EAN/GTIN barcodes (8-14 digit numbers as strings) from the products to optimize

tools.name: get_shop_info
tools.title: Shop Information
tools.description: Get an overview of all supported bike shops in the Bikefuchs network, including shipping cost tiers, free-shipping thresholds, and supported countries (Germany and Austria).

tools.name: get_shipping_breakdown
tools.title: Shipping Cost Breakdown
tools.description: Get the exact shipping cost for a specific shop, country, and cart value. Returns the shipping fee, free-shipping threshold, and whether the order qualifies for free shipping.

tools.name: find_alternatives_for_product
tools.title: Find Alternatives
tools.description: Discover which shops carry a specific product by EAN barcode, sorted by price. Use when a user found a product at one shop and wants to know if it's available cheaper elsewhere.

tools.name: resolve_product
tools.title: Resolve Product URL
tools.description: Resolve a bicycle product page URL from a supported shop into structured product data, including the product's EAN/GTIN, so it can then be price-compared across all shops. Use when a user pastes a product link.

url.description: Product page URL from a supported shop (e.g. 'https://www.rosebikes.de/p/<product-name>-<id>')

country.description: Country for pricing (DE or AT, default DE)
